svg.title: USTB trailed Superstate’s NAV
svg.desc: Scatterplot of 883 daily observations from 2024-06-27 to 2026-11-26. At 23:59:59 UTC, the active Chainlink USTB NAV per share minus the same-date Superstate label, divided by that issuer label, reached -5.86 basis points on 2024-07-29. The issuer label has no publication timestamp.

g.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
